parameters.args: I need to fit quadratic, cubic, and natural spline (df=4) models predicting colony Area from the proportion of strain 287 in swarm mixtures. The data contains pure strains (287 and 98) and mixture ratios. I need to determine which model fits best and find the maximum predicted colony area at the optimal frequency.

parameters.content:
# Read data
d <- read.csv("inputs/Swarm_2.csv", sep=",", header=TRUE, stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
cat("Columns:", paste(names(d), collapse=", "), "\n")
cat("Rows:", nrow(d), "\n")

# Inspect unique strains and ratios
cat("\nUnique StrainNumber:", unique(d$StrainNumber), "\n")
cat("Unique Ratio:", unique(d$Ratio), "\n")

# Compute proportion of strain 287
# For pure strains:
#   StrainNumber 287, Ratio 1:0 -> proportion 287 = 1.0
#   StrainNumber 98, Ratio 1:0  -> proportion 287 = 0.0
#   StrainNumber 1 is a different strain -> exclude
# For mixtures (StrainNumber 287_98):
#   Ratio "X:Y" means 287:98, so proportion 287 = X/(X+Y)

compute_proportion <- function(strain, ratio_str) {
  if (strain == 287 && ratio_str == "1:0") {
    return(1.0)  # pure 287
  } else if (strain == 98 && ratio_str == "1:0") {
    return(0.0)  # pure 98
  } else if (strain == "287_98") {
    parts <- as.numeric(strsplit(ratio_str, ":")[[1]])
    return(parts[1] / (parts[1] + parts[2]))
  } else {
    return(NA)
  }
}

d$prop287 <- mapply(compute_proportion, d$StrainNumber, d$Ratio)
cat("\nRows before filtering:", nrow(d), "\n")
d <- d[!is.na(d$prop287), ]
cat("Rows after filtering (287/98 system only):", nrow(d), "\n")

# Show data summary
cat("\nData summary:\n")
print(d[, c("StrainNumber", "Ratio", "Replicate", "Area", "prop287")])

# Fit models
library(splines)

m_quad <- lm(Area ~ prop287 + I(prop287^2), data = d)
m_cubic <- lm(Area ~ prop287 + I(prop287^2) + I(prop287^3), data = d)
m_ns <- lm(Area ~ ns(prop287, df = 4), data = d)

cat("\n===== Model summaries =====\n")
cat("\n--- Quadratic ---\n")
print(summary(m_quad))
cat("\n--- Cubic ---\n")
print(summary(m_cubic))
cat("\n--- Natural spline (df=4) ---\n")
print(summary(m_ns))

# Compare models using AIC and adjusted R²
cat("\n===== Model comparison =====\n")
cat("\nAIC:\n")
cat("  Quadratic:", AIC(m_quad), "\n")
cat("  Cubic:", AIC(m_cubic), "\n")
cat("  Natural spline:", AIC(m_ns), "\n")

cat("\nAdjusted R-squared:\n")
cat("  Quadratic:", summary(m_quad)$adj.r.squared, "\n")
cat("  Cubic:", summary(m_cubic)$adj.r.squared, "\n")
cat("  Natural spline:", summary(m_ns)$adj.r.squared, "\n")

cat("\nResidual standard error:\n")
cat("  Quadratic:", summary(m_quad)$sigma, "\n")
cat("  Cubic:", summary(m_cubic)$sigma, "\n")
cat("  Natural spline:", summary(m_ns)$sigma, "\n")

# Identify best model by lowest AIC
models <- list(quad = m_quad, cubic = m_cubic, ns = m_ns)
aic_vals <- sapply(models, AIC)
best_name <- names(which.min(aic_vals))
best_model <- models[[best_name]]
cat("\nBest model by AIC:", best_name, "\n")

# Also check by adj R²
adjr2_vals <- sapply(models, function(m) summary(m)$adj.r.squared)
cat("Best model by adj R²:", names(which.max(adjr2_vals)), "\n")

# Find optimum within [0, 1] for the best model
# Grid search on fine grid
grid <- seq(0, 1, length.out = 10001)
if (best_name == "quad") {
  pred <- predict(best_model, newdata = data.frame(prop287 = grid))
} else if (best_name == "cubic") {
  pred <- predict(best_model, newdata = data.frame(prop287 = grid))
} else {
  pred <- predict(best_model, newdata = data.frame(prop287 = grid))
}

opt_idx <- which.max(pred)
opt_prop <- grid[opt_idx]
opt_area <- pred[opt_idx]

cat("\n===== Optimum for best model (", best_name, ") =====\n", sep="")
cat("Optimal proportion of strain 287:", opt_prop, "\n")
cat("Maximum predicted colony area:", opt_area, "\n")

# Also compute optimum for all models for reference
cat("\n===== Optima for all models =====\n")
for (mname in c("quad", "cubic", "ns")) {
  m <- models[[mname]]
  pred_all <- predict(m, newdata = data.frame(prop287 = grid))
  idx <- which.max(pred_all)
  cat(mname, "- optimal prop:", grid[idx], "- max area:", pred_all[idx], "\n")
}

# Plot
png("fit_plot.png", width=800, height=600)
plot(d$prop287, d$Area, pch=19, col=rgb(0,0,0,0.6),
     xlab="Proportion of strain 287", ylab="Colony Area",
     main="Model fits for colony area vs. proportion of strain 287")
lines(grid, predict(m_quad, newdata=data.frame(prop287=grid)), col="blue", lwd=2)
lines(grid, predict(m_cubic, newdata=data.frame(prop287=grid)), col="red", lwd=2, lty=2)
lines(grid, predict(m_ns, newdata=data.frame(prop287=grid)), col="darkgreen", lwd=2, lty=3)
legend("topleft", legend=c("Quadratic","Cubic","Natural spline (df=4)"),
       col=c("blue","red","darkgreen"), lty=c(1,2,3), lwd=2)
dev.off()
cat("\nPlot saved to fit_plot.png\n")

events.command:
Rscript -e '
library(splines)
d <- read.csv("inputs/Swarm_2.csv")
compute_proportion <- function(strain, ratio_str) {
  if (strain == 287 && ratio_str == "1:0") return(1.0)
  else if (strain == 98 && ratio_str == "1:0") return(0.0)
  else if (strain == "287_98") {
    parts <- as.numeric(strsplit(ratio_str, ":")[[1]])
    return(parts[1] / (parts[1] + parts[2]))
  } else return(NA)
}
d$prop287 <- mapply(compute_proportion, d$StrainNumber, d$Ratio)
d <- d[!is.na(d$prop287), ]

# Best model: natural spline df=4
m_ns <- lm(Area ~ ns(prop287, df=4), data=d)

# Use optimise for precise optimum
obj <- function(p) predict(m_ns, newdata=data.frame(prop287=p))
opt <- optimise(obj, interval=c(0, 1), maximum=TRUE)
cat("Optimal proportion:", opt$maximum, "\n")
cat("Maximum predicted Area:", opt$objective, "\n")

# Also verify with very fine grid
grid <- seq(0.8, 0.95, length.out=100001)
pred <- predict(m_ns, newdata=data.frame(prop287=grid))
idx <- which.max(pred)
cat("Grid optimum prop:", grid[idx], "\n")
cat("Grid optimum area:", pred[idx], "\n")

# Also check the ANOVA comparison
cat("\nANOVA comparing models:\n")
m_quad <- lm(Area ~ prop287 + I(prop287^2), data=d)
m_cubic <- lm(Area ~ prop287 + I(prop287^2) + I(prop287^3), data=d)
cat("Quad vs Cubic:\n")
print(anova(m_quad, m_cubic))
cat("\nCubic vs Natural spline:\n")
print(anova(m_cubic, m_ns))
' 2>&1
